name: The Bellroot Warden
lore: A patient keeper, grown around an ancient bell.

name: The Copper Matron
lore: Her shell bears the scratches of forgotten caravans.

name: The Hollow Antler
lore: A quiet hunter beneath the stone.

name: The Kiln Regent
lore: The last guardian of a buried furnace.

name: The Salt Archivist
lore: A keeper of memories washed from the world.

name: The Glass Pilgrim
lore: Its long journey ended beneath the earth.

name: The Thorn Astronomer
lore: It traces constellations in the roots.

name: The Cinder Cantor
lore: Its wings sing of a sunless sky.

name: The Pale Architect
lore: It still builds for a vanished city.

name: The Night Orchard
lore: A thousand roots share one hunger.

name: The Last Meridian
lore: The dark folds around its wings.
